decision: PASS only if source bytes match their SHA and Git blob, one confirmed pair joins all exact identities, nested brackets agree, times and types are ordered, authority/effect remain false, the independent audit matches, and every mutation control rejects. Pin mismatch is STOP; semantic mismatch is FAIL.
hypothesis: After A01's retained source-pin STOP, a new source-pinned consumer can derive a conservative per-key interval from the same immutable down/up measurement pair without relabeling it as an authority-bearing transition.
scope: Offline replay of one retained fake-display pair. It does not measure a live X server, physical/game occupancy, application effect, useful feedback, threat response, recovery, or performance.
test: Replay the two-row retained A01 fake-display event stream exactly once through the corrected consumer; independently reconstruct from raw bytes; run ten in-memory regression and output-mutation controls.
